blurb: York's Wild Kingdom is a privately owned zoo and amusement park featuring wild animals from around the world and family-friendly rides. Visitors can explore the Butterfly Kingdom exhibit and interact with over 300 parakeets in the Parakeet Encounter. The park promotes education and conservation through its animal exhibits and offers a fun day trip for families.
extraNote: Tickets bought online may be redeemed any day during the 2026 season · May 23rd - September 27th

quotes.author: Mara D
quotes.text: My of my favorite zoos to visit. I was there this past weekend. The weather was perfect. The packing lot was filled by 10:30 but the actual zoo was not crowded at all. The animals looked content and very comforable. I was able to finally see the lion up close but he was sleeping. I am definitely going back in August. A great place to visit.

quotes.author: Mara D
quotes.text: At the end of the summer, I had an opportunity to go on a mini vacation by myself. The must go to place ….. was this zoo. Being a photographer and author myself, I was in my glory. I walked and walked around the zoo for hours talking photos. The zoo was clean and easy to walk around.

quotes.author: Hannah M
quotes.text: everyone can see lots of animals at the zoo and everyone can have fun at the zoos and they can take pictures of animals if they want to and it would be amazing to have the pictures to remember the days that people went to the zoos and have an amazing time there

quotes.author: Tammy R
quotes.text: A favorite place to come to. We have been com6tk York for 40 years and do the animal kingdom every couple years. Love the paddle boat and feeding the ducks. Kids miss the elephant ride but Enjoyed the very brief camel ride.

quotes.author: Kristen C
quotes.text: Pleasant grounds with surprising number is animals. The parakeet area was really fun even for 16 yr old. Bring quarters for animal feed machines. Great for little kids.

quotes.author: James S
quotes.text: This kingdom and zoo certainly allows children fun rides food and animals all in one place. A bit aging and needs a facelift but the kids love it.
